title: Shortcuts Alt+* shadows other shortcuts such as Alt+Ctrl+* and Alt+Ctrl+Shift+*

status.label: Waiting to confirm the exact-match setting
status.detail: The report says Alt+D to Send Text shadows longer Alt+Ctrl+D and Alt+Ctrl+Shift+D shortcuts; a commenter asked whether the exact-match option fixes it, with no author reply.

judgment.rationale: The report says an Alt+D Send Text mapping outputs Delta, but longer Alt+Ctrl+D and Alt+Ctrl+Shift+D shortcuts assigned through MSKLC also produce Delta instead of their expected symbols. A commenter distinguishes Send Text from Send Key/Shortcut behavior and another asks whether the exact-match option added in 0.88.0 resolves the conflict. No author response follows. That setting is the next discriminating check, so do not repeat the request.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.88.00 and describes Alt+D mapped to send Greek Delta.
The longer Alt+Ctrl+D and Alt+Ctrl+Shift+D shortcuts are assigned through MSKLC but produce Delta rather than their assigned symbols.
A commenter notes the issue may differ for Send Text versus Send Key/Shortcut actions.
A commenter asked on 2025-03-07 whether the exact-match option fixes the conflict; there has been no author reply.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the author to test the exact-match option and report whether it preserves the longer MSKLC shortcuts.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report uses PowerToys 0.88.00, where the exact-match option was available, and the existing question asking whether it resolves the conflict remains unanswered. A code fix should not be proposed until that targeted setting is tested.

issue_context.summary: An Alt+D Send Text mapping reportedly shadows longer Alt+Ctrl+D and Alt+Ctrl+Shift+D shortcuts; the exact-match setting has not been tested in the thread.
known_information: Alt+D is configured to send Greek Delta; Alt+Ctrl+D and Alt+Ctrl+Shift+D are configured in MSKLC to produce Degree and Diameter.
The longer shortcuts reportedly produce Delta rather than their assigned symbols.
A commenter asked whether the exact-match option resolves the conflict; there is no author response.
inferences: The shorter Send Text mapping may be matching a prefix of the longer shortcut, but this has not been confirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The report distinguishes Send Text from Send Key/Shortcut behavior, and the version includes an exact-match setting that may alter prefix matching. Preserve the existing request to test that setting before treating the behavior as a code defect.
initial_investigation: Read the current issue body and both comments; there are no assignees or linked fixes.
Confirmed the latest comment asks whether the exact-match option fixes the conflict and remains unanswered.

information_gaps.information: Whether enabling exact match for Alt+D allows the longer Alt+Ctrl+D and Alt+Ctrl+Shift+D MSKLC shortcuts to produce their assigned symbols
information_gaps.why_needed: The exact-match option may be the intended way to prevent the shorter Send Text mapping from matching longer chords.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Enable exact match on the Alt+D remap, then test the two longer MSKLC shortcuts and report each resulting character.
